Bengaluru Metro Pink Line stretch nears public opening

A 7.5-kilometer stretch of Bengaluru Metro's Pink Line, covering six stations, is reportedly ready for public operations. Karnataka Minister Krishna Byre Gowda stated that the elevated line is prepared for inauguration, with the Centre's approval pending. The stretch is expected to open this month.
